comment: What a rented box is provisioned WITH, per tier — edited from the studio's Rental build page (Advanced) and committed here on purpose. `loras` pins installed LoRA ids to a tier; with no pins the tier falls back to every registered LoRA whose base-model family it serves. `checkpoints` maps a default weight's models/ destination to an installed checkpoint that stands in for it, landing under the default's filename so every graph keeps resolving. A swap names its source and never a credential: source "huggingface" carries a public file URL used verbatim, and source "civitai" carries the version/file ids whose signed download URL is resolved on the studio machine once per rental — so the box is handed a presigned URL, exactly like the ones our own bucket gives it, and never a token. A signed URL is deliberately NOT stored here: it expires, and it is a capability anyone reading the repo could spend. Upload state and R2 keys are machine state and live in ~/.hivemindos/media-studio/rental-loras.json.
